verdict.rationale: The docs show Financial Connections collecting and verifying a connected bank account for ACH Direct Debit payments inside the payment flow, so you can pull a bank payment from a linked account (docs-8, docs-16, docs-17, docs-19). This is an ACH debit integration that relies on Stripe payments, not a standalone payment-initiation API. Live geography is never stated in the docs; only community comments say it is US-only (comm-9, comm-11). Missing for 10: a documented payment-initiation (pay-by-bank) API, first-party statement of live geographies, a payment-initiation flow beyond ACH debit, and hands-on corroboration of payment execution.
